import sys,json,time,socket,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/lhl/hipEngine')
import httpx
from scripts.qwen4exp_sampled_mtp_http_gate import extract
r={'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'snapshots':[]}
p=Path('/tmp/he-socket-mtp-backpressure-report.json')
def save():p.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
with httpx.Client(base_url='http://127.0.0.1:18389',timeout=180) as c:
 deadline=time.monotonic()+600
 while True:
  try:
   ready=c.get('/ready',timeout=5)
   if ready.status_code==200 and ready.json().get('ready'):break
  except httpx.TransportError:pass
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('ready')
  time.sleep(1)
 c.post('/v1/completions',json=dict(model='qwen38fn-sampling',prompt='Hello',max_tokens=8,temperature=0,speculative=False)).raise_for_status()
 r['metrics_before']=c.get('/metrics').text
 assert 'last_work_kind="decode"' in r['metrics_before']
 body=dict(model='qwen38fn-sampling',messages=[dict(role='user',content='Print every integer from 1 through 1000, one per line. Do not skip any numbers and do not abbreviate the list.')],enable_thinking=False,temperature=0,max_tokens=7800,speculative=True,stream=True,logprobs=True,top_logprobs=20,stream_options=dict(include_usage=True,include_hipengine=True))
 r['request']=body
 s=socket.socket();s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_RCVBUF,1024);s.settimeout(30);s.connect(('127.0.0.1',18389));r['client_port']=s.getsockname()[1]
 raw=json.dumps(body).encode();s.sendall(b'POST /v1/chat/completions HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\r\n\r\n'+raw)
 # Read only enough to establish SSE admission, then stop draining entirely.
 headers=b''
 while b'\r\n\r\n' not in headers:headers+=s.recv(1)
 r['headers']=headers.decode();assert b'200 OK' in headers,headers
 start=time.monotonic()
 try:
  for i in range(8):
   time.sleep(5)
   snap=subprocess.check_output(['ss','-tn','sport = :18389'],text=True)
   r['snapshots'].append(dict(seconds=time.monotonic()-start,ss=snap));save()
  r['metrics_before_drain']=c.get('/metrics').text
  save()
  assert 'last_work_kind="verify_chain"' in r['metrics_before_drain'], r['metrics_before_drain']
  s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_RCVBUF,1048576)
  data=b''
  deadline=time.monotonic()+90
  while b'data: [DONE]' not in data:
   block=s.recv(65536)
   if not block:break
   data+=block
   if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('drain')
  r['drained_bytes']=len(data)
  r['wire_tail']=data[-12000:].decode(errors='replace')
  Path('/tmp/he-socket-mtp-backpressure-wire.txt').write_bytes(data)
  r['mtp_verify_chain_observed']=True
  assert b'data: [DONE]' in data, r['wire_tail']
  assert b'client_backpressure' in data, r['wire_tail']
  r['client_backpressure_terminal_proven']=True
  save()
 finally:s.close()
 r['metrics_after_disconnect']=c.get('/metrics').text
 recovered=[]
 for i in range(2):
  request=dict(model='qwen38fn-sampling',prompt='Explain a rainbow in one sentence.',temperature=0,max_tokens=16,speculative=True,logprobs=5)
  response=c.post('/v1/completions',json=request);response.raise_for_status()
  result=extract(response.json(),chat=False);recovered.append(result)
  assert result['mtp']['used'] and result['mtp']['draft_cycles'] > 0, result
 assert recovered[0]['ids']==recovered[1]['ids']
 assert recovered[0]['text']==recovered[1]['text']
 r['recovery']=recovered;r['ready_after']=c.get('/ready').json();r['metrics_after_recovery']=c.get('/metrics').text
 r['recovery_passed']=True;save();print('Recovery passed; inspect ss snapshots and cancellation counters before qualifying backpressure',flush=True)
